en.${host} 未在 ${timeout} ms 内响应 SNTP 请求: ${host} did not answer the SNTP request within ${timeout} ms
en.32 位整数在十进制/十六进制/二进制/八进制之间换算，可逐位开关，也能做移位与: Convert a 32-bit integer between decimal, hexadecimal, binary and octal, toggle individual bits, and run shifts or logic operations.
en.32 位整数换算与按位切换：十进制/十六进制/二进制/八进制互转、逐位开关、移位: 32-bit integer conversion and bit toggling: decimal, hex, binary and octal, one switch per bit, shifts and logic operations.
en.32 位无符号整数。点任意一位翻转（高位在左）；有符号十进制按二进制补码解释。: A 32-bit unsigned integer. Click any bit to toggle it (most significant first); the signed decimal reading uses two’s complement.
en.ARP 缓存是空的（没有最近通信过的邻居）: The ARP cache is empty (no neighbour has been contacted recently)
en.ARP 表为空，可能需要先与本网段通信或提升权限: ARP table is empty; you may need traffic on this subnet first or elevated privileges
en.DNS 服务器不可达，域名解析会失败，但 IP 直连可能仍然正常。: DNS server unreachable; name resolution will fail, but direct IP connections may still work.
en.HTTP 大文件上下行吞吐，默认走 Cloudflare 端点；单节点结果不能代: Up/down throughput over a large HTTP transfer, using Cloudflare endpoints by default. A single node does not represent the whole path.
en.ICMP 回环测试：逐包往返时间、TTL 与丢包统计。使用系统 ping，无需管: ICMP echo test: per-packet round-trip time, TTL and loss statistics. Uses system ping; no administrator privileges required.
en.IP 地址（未关联时可手填）: IP address (fill in when not bound)
en.IP 地址（添加 / 删除时必填）: IP address (required to add or delete)
en.IP 地址（留空 = 本机公网出口）: IP address (empty = this machine public egress)
en.LCS 逐行对比，按新增/删除/修改着色；左右两侧都可以直接粘文本，也可以选两份: Line-by-line LCS diff coloured by added/removed/changed. Either side accepts pasted text or a stored backup.
en.RDAP 查询失败（${reason}），改用 whois 43 端口: RDAP query failed (${reason}); falling back to whois port 43
en.SNMP v2c GET 读 SYSTEM 组（sysName / sysDes: SNMP v2c GET on the SYSTEM group (sysName / sysDescr / sysObjectID / uptime), and guesses the vendor from it.
en.SNMP v2c 读取 SYSTEM 组：sysName / sysDescr: Reads the SNMP v2c SYSTEM group: sysName / sysDescr / sysObjectID / uptime, far more accurate than guessing the vendor from a MAC.
en.SNTP 响应模式不合法（mode=${mode}）: The SNTP reply has an invalid mode (mode=${mode})
en.SNTP 响应长度不合法（${size} 字节）: The SNTP reply has an invalid length (${size} bytes)
en.SSH 与 Telnet 交互终端：保存设备、一键连接交换机与 Linux 主机: Interactive SSH and Telnet terminal: save devices, connect to switches and Linux hosts in one click, and switch between UTF-8 and GBK.
en.SSH/Telnet 批量执行命令，自动翻页；输出可归档到本机备份库，供配置对比: Runs commands over SSH/Telnet in batch with automatic paging; the output can be archived as a backup for diffing and questions.
en.SSH/Telnet 批量连接华为 VRP、H3C、思科 IOS/NX-OS，执: Connects to Huawei VRP, H3C and Cisco IOS/NX-OS devices in bulk over SSH/Telnet, runs commands, handles paging automatically and archives configurations locally.
en.SYN 快扫与原始套接字抓包未包含在内。: SYN fast scan and raw-socket packet capture are not included.
en.TCP 443 出站失败：可能存在防火墙/代理拦截。: TCP 443 outbound failed: a firewall or proxy may be blocking it.
en.TCP connect 扫描（不需管理员权限），可选取 banner 识别服务。: TCP connect scan (no administrator privileges needed); optionally grabs banners to identify services.
en.TCP connect 扫描，会与目标建立完整连接；开启 banner 抓取会多: A TCP connect scan establishes a full connection. Grabbing banners costs a few hundred milliseconds but reveals the protocol and version.
en.TCP 模式只探测列出的端口，ICMP 模式需要系统允许发 ping。同一网段建: TCP mode only probes the listed ports; ICMP mode needs ping to be allowed. On the local subnet "Scan LAN" is much faster.
en.[${deviceName}] 输出看起来包含设备配置: [${deviceName}] output appears to contain device configuration
en.下载 iperf3 for Windows 压缩包，解压出 iperf3.exe: Download the iperf3 for Windows archive, extract iperf3.exe and put it in the directory above; this tool looks there first, then on PATH
en.下载 iperf3 for Windows 并解压，把 iperf3.exe 放: Download iperf3 for Windows, unzip it, and put iperf3.exe in PATH or in the same directory as this tool
en.为什么硬盘标称和系统显示不一样: Why the label and the operating system disagree
en.从粘贴内容解析出 ${count} 条邻居: Parsed ${count} neighbour(s) from the pasted text
en.优先 RDAP（JSON 接口），失败再回退到 whois:43 原始文本；域名: Tries RDAP (JSON) first and falls back to raw whois:43 text. Domains and IP addresses are both accepted.
en.优先使用 RDAP（JSON 结构），失败时回退到 whois 43 端口原始文: Prefers RDAP (JSON structure) and falls back to raw whois text on port 43.
en.先向网段发 UDP 触发 ARP，再读本机 ARP 表，所以只限同一广播域；跨网: Sends UDP across the subnet to populate ARP, then reads the local ARP table, so it only covers one broadcast domain; use IP scan across subnets. Vendors come from the offline OUI subset.
en.先在列表里选中一台设备: Select a device in the list first
en.先在列表里选中一条: Select a row in the table first
en.先填写 IP 与 MAC: Fill in both IP and MAC first
en.写入 ARP 缓存需要管理员权限，请以管理员身份运行 DSH 后重试: Writing the ARP cache needs administrator rights: restart DSH as administrator and retry
en.写入邻居表需要 root 权限，请用 sudo 启动 DSH 后重试: Writing the neighbour table needs root: start DSH with sudo and retry
en.列出本机 TCP/UDP 套接字：监听端口、已建立连接、对应进程与 PID。只读: List this machine TCP/UDP sockets: listening ports, established connections, owning process and PID. Read-only; nothing is changed.
en.列出本机网卡、地址、网关、DNS、MAC 与公网出口 IP。Windows 下读: Lists local NICs, addresses, gateway, DNS, MAC and public egress IP. On Windows it reads Get-NetIPConfiguration.
en.十进制（KB/MB/GB/TB）与二进制（KiB/MiB/GiB/TiB）两套口: Both decimal (KB/MB/GB/TB) and binary (KiB/MiB/GiB/TiB) readings are shown; the drive-size difference is the unit, not lost capacity.
en.华为 VRP / H3C Comware 与思科 IOS / NX-OS 的命令: Command equivalents across Huawei VRP / H3C Comware and Cisco IOS / NX-OS, searchable by keyword in Chinese or English and filterable by category.
en.华为 VRP/H3C Comware 与思科 IOS/NX-OS 命令对照，可搜: Searchable command mapping between Huawei VRP/H3C Comware and Cisco IOS/NX-OS.
en.单个地址，或用下方批量框: Single address, or use the batch box below
en.单包默认 32 字节、间隔 1 秒。RTT 从系统 ping 输出解析，<1 表: 32-byte packets, one per second by default. RTT is parsed from the system ping output; <1 means under 1 ms. To probe the MTU, try a packet size around 1400.
en.厂商标称用 10 进制（1 GB = 1000³ 字节），操作系统按 2 进制显: Vendors advertise decimal units (1 GB = 1000³ bytes) while the operating system displays binary ones (1 GiB = 1024³ bytes); the difference is the unit, not lost capacity.
en.双击跳到终端: Double-click to jump to the terminal
en.发 6 个 FF + 16 次 MAC 的魔术包（UDP 9）。目标机需要在 B: Sends the 6×FF + 16×MAC magic packet on UDP 9. The target must have wake-on-LAN enabled in both the BIOS and the NIC driver.
en.发送 UDP 魔术包（6×FF + 16 次 MAC）。可把设备连同名称一起保存: Sends a UDP magic packet (6×FF + MAC × 16). Save devices with names, then wake them with one click in the list below.
en.只读取时间，不修改系统时钟。UDP 123 被防火墙挡住时会显示无响应，换一台服: Only reads the time; the system clock is never changed. If UDP 123 is blocked the server shows no answer, so try another one.
en.只读本机套接字表，不发起任何连接。Windows 下 PID 通过 taskli: Reads the local socket table and opens no connections. On Windows the PID is mapped to a process name through tasklist.
en.同时打开的监控过多（上限 ${max}）: Too many monitors are open at the same time (limit ${max})
en.向 NTP/SNTP 服务器取时，算出本机时钟快慢与请求往返时延。只读时间，不会: Ask an NTP/SNTP server for the time and compute how far this clock is off, plus the round-trip delay. It only reads time; the system clock is never changed.
en.在画布上拖出一个矩形框，用来圈出一片区域: Drag on the canvas to lay out a frame around an area
en.域名解析失败：请检查 DNS 配置或上游 DNS 是否可用。: Name resolution failed: check the DNS configuration or whether the upstream DNS is reachable.
en.基于 HTTP 大文件上下行的吞吐测试（默认 Cloudflare 测速端点），: Throughput test over large HTTP uploads/downloads (Cloudflare endpoint by default), with no dependency on Ookla's proprietary protocol.
en.填写完成后点右上角「连接」: Fill this in, then click Connect
en.填好名称和 MAC 后点「保存设备」，之后就能在表格里一键唤醒。: Fill in the name and MAC, click "Save device", then wake it from the table with one click.
en.备份存放在 ~/.dsh-nwtool/backups，可搜索、查看与删除；旁边: Backups live in ~/.dsh-nwtool/backups and can be searched, read and deleted; one click hands one to the model for analysis.
en.多标签交互终端。监控与文件浏览各用一条独立连接，不会打断当前画面；关掉标签才会断: A tabbed interactive terminal. Monitoring and file browsing each use their own connection so the screen is never disturbed; a session ends only when its tab is closed.
en.字节、比特与 KB/MB/GB/TB、KiB/MiB/GiB/TiB 互转，并算: Convert between bytes, bits, KB/MB/GB/TB and KiB/MiB/GiB/TiB, and see why a "500 GB" drive shows as 465 GiB.
en.对指定 TCP 端口做连接计时，ICMP 被过滤时判断可达性最有效。: Times TCP connections to a specified port; the most reliable reachability check when ICMP is filtered.
en.对网段/地址范围并发探测，列出在线主机。TCP 模式无需权限，ICMP 模式更贴: Concurrently probes a subnet/address range and lists online hosts. TCP mode needs no privileges; ICMP mode is closer to a classic ping sweep.
en.局域网扫描 ${cidr}（${name}）· 通过 ARP 表发现主机: LAN scan ${cidr} (${name}) · Discover hosts via the ARP table
en.已选中「${name}」，点「连接」建立会话: Selected "${name}". Press Connect to open a session.
en.并发查询多个公共 DNS 的同一批域名，按平均时延排序。结果受本地出口线路与运营: Queries the same names against several public resolvers in parallel and sorts by average latency. Results depend on your uplink and carrier caching.
en.并发测试主流公共 DNS 的解析时延，按最快排序，用于挑选本地最优解析器。: Concurrently tests resolution latency of major public DNS services, sorted fastest first, to pick the best local resolver.
en.并排高亮两份配置/备份的差异，定位接口、ACL 等具体变动。: Highlights the differences between two configurations/backups side by side to pinpoint changes to interfaces, ACLs and more.
en.广播地址不是合法的 IPv4: ${broadcast}: Broadcast address is not a valid IPv4 address: ${broadcast}
en.归属地来自公共 API（多源回退），内网与保留地址在本地判断、不外发。不同服务的: Location data comes from public APIs with fallbacks; private and reserved ranges are classified locally and never sent. Providers disagree about details.
en.所有外网探测都不通：问题可能在 ISP 线路或出口设备。: All internet probes failed: the issue may be the ISP line or the egress device.
en.所有探测都在运行 DSH 的主机侧执行：Ping 通过系统 ping，端口扫描为: All probes run on the host running DSH: Ping uses the system ping, port scans use TCP connect mode, and neither requires administrator rights;
en.手工绘制的简易拓扑：摆放路由器/交换机/服务器/PC、连线成图，右键可关联设备簿: A simple hand-drawn topology: place routers, switches, servers and PCs, link them, right-click to bind a saved device, and double-click to jump to the terminal.
en.手工绘制的简易拓扑：摆放路由器、交换机、无线 AC/AP、服务器与 PC，连线成: A simple hand-drawn topology: place routers, switches, wireless ACs/APs, servers and PCs, then link them; right-click to bind a saved device and double-click to jump to the terminal.
en.拖动移动设备，工具栏「连线」后依次点两台设备即可连线；右键设备可关联设备簿里的条: Drag to move a device; press "Link" and click two devices to connect them. Right-click a device to bind a device-book entry, double-click to jump to the terminal with it selected. The sketch is saved to ~/.dsh-nwtool/topology.json.
en.拖动移动，右键关联设备，双击跳到终端: Drag to move · right-click to bind · double-click to jump
en.按 网卡 → 网关 → DNS → 域名解析 → 外网 → TCP 出站 → 公: Runs adapter → gateway → DNS → resolution → internet → TCP egress → public address in order, with a verdict per step so the break point is obvious.
en.按轮次重复路由追踪，统计每跳丢包率、平均/最好/最差时延与抖动。每一轮相当于一次: Repeats route tracing by round, collecting per-hop loss rate, average/best/worst latency and jitter. Each round is a full tracert.
en.提示：DSH 没有向已有输入框注入文本的插件接口，因此这里把配置和问题整理成提示: Note: DSH has no plugin API for injecting text into an existing input box, so the configuration and question are combined into a prompt and placed on the clipboard; just paste it after starting a new session.
en.握手成功即算通，耗时含三次握手。端口未开放会得到 RST 而不是超时，可据此区分: A completed handshake counts as reachable, and the time includes the three-way handshake. A closed port answers with RST rather than timing out, which separates "filtered" from "no service".
en.操作数不是合法的 32 位值: The operand is not a valid 32-bit value
en.无法取得公网出口 IP：可能是出口被 NAT 且探测服务不可达，或外网被隔离。: Could not obtain the public egress IP: egress may be behind NAT and the probe service unreachable, or the internet may be isolated.
en.无法执行 ${command}，请确认系统已安装该命令: Cannot run ${command}; make sure the command is installed
en.无法确定本机公网出口地址：${detail}: Could not determine the public egress address: ${detail}
en.无法解析输入的时间: Unable to parse the input time
en.无（内网/保留地址没有公网归属）: None (private and reserved addresses have no public location)
en.时间戳与日期互转、时区换算、相对时间，纯本地计算。: Timestamp/date conversion, time zone conversion and relative time, all computed locally.
en.显示在矩形框底部: Shown at the bottom of the frame
en.显示在线中间: Shown at the middle of the line
en.未发现开放端口（目标可能被防火墙过滤）: No open ports found (the target may be filtered by a firewall)
en.未发现明显故障：本机、网关、DNS、外网出口均可达。: No obvious fault found: the local host, gateway, DNS, and internet egress are all reachable.
en.未取得 Windows 网卡详情，已回退到 Node 网卡列表（${reason: Could not read the Windows adapter details; falling back to the Node adapter list (${reasons})
en.未填写地址：先查询本机公网出口: No address given: looking up the public egress address first
en.未找到 SSH 客户端：请安装 PuTTY 的 plink.exe 或启用 Wi: SSH client not found: install PuTTY's plink.exe or enable the built-in Windows OpenSSH client
en.未找到 iperf3 可执行文件。: The iperf3 executable was not found.
en.未确认到达目标，可能已达到最大跳数或路径被防火墙过滤: Target reachability not confirmed; the maximum number of hops may have been reached or the path may be filtered by a firewall
en.未确认到达目标；部分运营商设备不回 ICMP，中间跳出现丢包不代表业务受损。: Target reachability not confirmed; some carrier devices do not respond to ICMP, so packet loss at intermediate hops does not necessarily mean the service is affected.
en.未能获取连接票据: Could not obtain a connection ticket
en.未读取到默认网关: Could not read the default gateway
en.本机时钟偏差较大：比标准时间${direction} ${value}: This clock is far off: ${value} ${direction} of standard time
en.本机时钟比标准时间${direction} ${value}: This clock is ${value} ${direction} of standard time
en.本机没有获得 IPv4 地址，请检查网线/WiFi 与 DHCP。: This machine has no IPv4 address; check the network cable/WiFi and DHCP.
en.本机网段过大，请手动填写要扫描的网段: Local subnet is too large; enter the subnet to scan manually
en.构造原始 DNS 报文：可指定 DNS 服务器、记录类型与是否递归，输出含 TT: Builds raw DNS messages: specify the DNS server, record type and recursion; output includes TTL, flags and the authority section.
en.查 A/AAAA/CNAME/MX/TXT/NS/SOA/SRV/CAA/PTR: Queries A/AAAA/CNAME/MX/TXT/NS/SOA/SRV/CAA/PTR and shows the raw answer records and TTL directly.
en.查看、搜索、删除本机归档的设备配置备份。: View, search and delete locally archived device configuration backups.
en.查看不需要权限；添加、删除与清空需要管理员权限（Windows）或 root（L: Reading needs no privileges; adding, deleting and clearing need administrator rights (Windows) or root (Linux). A refusal is echoed exactly as the system reported it.
en.查看本机 ARP / 邻居缓存，可添加静态条目、删除单条或清空。写入缓存需要管理: Inspect the local ARP / neighbour cache and add a static entry, delete one, or clear it. Writing needs administrator rights; a refusal is reported as it happened.
en.查看本机 ARP / 邻居缓存；添加静态条目、删除选中条目或清空整张表。写入需要: Inspect the local ARP / neighbour cache; add a static entry, delete the selected one, or clear the table. Writing needs administrator rights.
en.查询 IP 的归属地、运营商与 ASN；留空则先查本机公网出口。内网与保留地址在: Look up an IP address location, ISP and ASN; leave it empty to look up this machine public egress first. Private and reserved ranges are classified locally and never sent anywhere.
en.树根（设备名，留空 = 自动选连接最多的一台）: Root (device name; empty = the node with the most links)
en.每一轮都是一次完整路由追踪，按跳统计。中间跳偶发丢包通常只是控制面限速，末跳丢包: Each round is a full path trace, aggregated per hop. Occasional loss at middle hops is usually control-plane rate limiting; loss at the last hop is real.
en.没有从粘贴内容里解析出 LLDP/CDP 邻居: No LLDP/CDP neighbour could be parsed from the pasted text
en.没有任何公共 DNS 返回结果，请检查本机出网与 53/UDP 策略: No public DNS returned results; check local outbound connectivity and 53/UDP policy
en.没有找到可用的本机 IPv4 网卡: No usable local IPv4 adapter found
en.没有服务器应答，无法判断: No server answered, so the clock cannot be judged
en.没有读到任何套接字，可能缺少 netstat/ss 命令: No socket could be read; the netstat/ss command may be missing
en.没有采集到任何邻居关系。请确认设备已开启 LLDP/CDP（display ll: No neighbour relationship was collected. Make sure LLDP/CDP is enabled on the devices (display lldp / show lldp), or use paste mode.
en.测试 ${domain} 的 ${type} 记录 · ${count} 个公共: Test ${type} record of ${domain} · ${count} public DNS servers · ${rounds} rounds each
en.浏览器不支持流式响应: Browser does not support streaming responses
en.浏览设备上的文件: Browse the files on the device
en.点「查看列表」读取本机 ARP 缓存: Click Show the table to read the local ARP cache
en.点任意一位翻转（高位在左）: Click a bit to toggle it (most significant bit on the left)
en.点左上角的设备类型开始画：拖动移动，工具栏「连线」后依次点两台设备: Pick a device type in the top-left to start: drag to move, press "Link" then click two devices to connect them.
en.监控会话不存在: The monitor session does not exist
en.监控会话尚未就绪: The monitor session is not ready yet
en.确定要清空本机 ARP 缓存？清空后与邻居的通信会重新学习，期间可能短暂中断。: Clear the local ARP cache? Traffic to neighbours relearns it and may pause briefly while it does.
en.粘贴数据对应的设备名: Device name the pasted data belongs to
en.精简版 Postman：构造请求、查看状态/响应头/耗时并在 Host 侧发出（: A lean Postman: build a request, inspect status/response headers/timing and send it from the Host side (no browser CORS limits).
en.纯本地计算。时间戳支持秒与毫秒，时区换算以浏览器所在时区为基准。: Pure local arithmetic. Timestamps accept seconds or milliseconds, and time-zone conversion is relative to the browser zone.
en.纯本地计算，不发任何网络请求。「额外划分层数」最多 4 层，每层最多列出 16: Pure local arithmetic, no network requests. "Extra split depth" goes up to 4 levels and lists at most 16 subnets per level.
en.纯本地计算：掩码换算、网络/广播地址、可用范围、二进制与子网划分，不发任何网络请: Pure local computation: mask conversion, network/broadcast addresses, usable range, binary and subnetting, with no network requests.
en.终端通道拒绝了这次连接（${reason}）: The terminal channel refused this connection (${reason})
en.编排式诊断：本机网卡 → 网关 → DNS → 域名解析 → 外网连通 → TC: Orchestrated diagnosis: local NIC → gateway → DNS → name resolution → internet reachability → TCP egress → public egress, with readable conclusions.
en.网关 ${gateway} 不通：问题多半在本机到交换机这一段（网线、VLAN、: Gateway ${gateway} unreachable: the problem is most likely between this machine and the switch (cable, VLAN, ARP).
en.网卡、网关、DNS 与公网出口都取自本机。「公网出口」会依次请求多个探测源，失败: Adapters, gateways, DNS and the public egress address all come from this machine. The egress lookup tries several providers and lists the ones that failed.
en.网络运维工具箱渲染失败: Network Operations Toolbox failed to render
en.自己拼 DNS 报文，可指定服务器、类型与递归位；输出含 flags、ANSWE: Builds the DNS message itself, so you choose the server, the type and the recursion bit; the output shows flags, the ANSWER/AUTHORITY sections and each TTL.
en.要更新的设备不在列表中: The device to update is not in the list
en.设备簿里没有这台设备，可能已被删除: That device is not in the book; it may have been deleted
en.请分析这份设备配置：指出潜在风险、冗余配置和可以优化的地方。: Analyze this device configuration: point out potential risks, redundant configuration, and areas for optimization.
en.请填写 SNTP 服务器: Enter at least one SNTP server
en.请填写合法的 MAC 地址（如 00-11-22-33-44-55）: Enter a valid MAC address (such as 00-11-22-33-44-55)
en.请填写完整域名，例如 example.com: Enter a full domain, e.g. example.com
en.请填写端口或端口范围: Enter a port or port range
en.请填写设备清单，或粘贴一份 LLDP/CDP 输出: Enter a device list, or paste an LLDP/CDP output
en.请求体不是合法 JSON: Request body is not valid JSON
en.请求由主机侧发出，因此不受浏览器跨域限制。请求头每行一条 key: value，: The request is sent from the Host side, so browser CORS does not apply. One key: value header per line; redirects can be followed or not.
en.请确认：设备已启用 SNMP v2c、community 正确（默认 publi: Please confirm: SNMP v2c is enabled on the device, the community is correct (default public), UDP 161 is not blocked by an ACL or firewall, and the management interface route is reachable.
en.读 arp -a / ip neigh 的结果；添加、删除、清空属于写操作，需要: Reads the output of arp -a / ip neigh. Adding, deleting and clearing are writes and need administrator rights (Windows) or root (Linux).
en.读取交换机上的 LLDP/CDP 邻居表（也可直接粘贴现成输出），合并成拓扑图并: Read the LLDP/CDP neighbour tables from switches (or paste an existing output), merge them into one graph and draw it as a tree from the root you choose. This is not packet capture: it needs device credentials.
en.读设备现有的 LLDP/CDP 邻居表再拼图，不是抓包：需要设备登录凭据，或者直: Reads the LLDP/CDP neighbour tables the devices already keep and merges them. Not packet capture: it needs device credentials, or paste an output instead.
en.调用本机 iperf3 二进制（-J 解析 JSON）。未安装时给出获取方式，不: Runs the local iperf3 binary (-J JSON parsing). If it is not installed, shows how to get it; no third-party executables are bundled.
en.调用本机 iperf3 并解析 -J JSON。没装的话，把 iperf3.ex: Runs the local iperf3 and parses its -J JSON. If it is missing, drop iperf3.exe into the directory the panel names.
en.调用系统 tracert / traceroute；中间设备不回 TTL 超时包: Runs the system tracert / traceroute. A hop that does not answer with an ICMP TTL expiry is shown as *; a missing last hop means the target is unreachable.
en.走系统解析器。要指定 DNS 服务器、看 TTL 与权威段，请改用 dig。: Uses the system resolver. To choose a DNS server or read TTLs and the authority section, use dig.
en.路径不能以横线开头: ${path}: A path may not start with a dash: ${path}
en.路径只能包含字母、数字、点、斜杠、冒号、横线: ${path}: A path may only contain letters, digits, dots, slashes, colons and dashes: ${path}
en.输入新名称即可创建分组: Type a new name to create a group
en.这个值不是 32 位整数，或与所选进制不符: This is not a 32-bit integer, or it does not match the selected base
en.这台设备还没关联设备簿条目，右键可以先关联: This device is not bound to a device-book entry yet; right-click to bind one
en.连线模式：依次点两台设备: Link mode: click two devices in order
en.选一份备份生成提示词，复制后在新的会话里提问；不会自动把整份配置发出去。: Pick a backup to build a prompt, copy it and ask in a new session. The full configuration is never sent automatically.
en.选中一个设备或连线来编辑: Select a device or a link to edit it
en.选中一份备份作为上下文，一键复制提示词并在新会话中向大模型提问。: Select a backup as context, copy the prompt in one click and ask the model in a new session.
en.选择左侧设备，或点「新建」添加一个: Pick a device on the left, or click New to add one
en.逐跳显示路径与每一跳的往返时延（调用系统 tracert / tracerout: Shows the path hop by hop with per-hop round-trip latency (uses system tracert / traceroute; no administrator privileges required).
en.通过 ARP 表发现在线主机（Windows 下免管理员），可反解主机名并查厂商: Discovers online hosts via the ARP table (no admin needed on Windows); can reverse-resolve hostnames and look up vendors.
en.需要两份配置内容或两个备份文件: Two configuration contents or two backup files required
en.需要指定备份文件或直接提供内容: Specify a backup file or provide content directly
en.魔术包已发送。目标主机需在 BIOS/网卡中开启 Wake-on-LAN，且与本: Magic packet sent. The target host must have Wake-on-LAN enabled in the BIOS/NIC and be in the same broadcast domain as this machine.
en.上次的会话已结束，可以重新连接: The previous session has ended; you can reconnect
en.已恢复 ${count} 个标签页，后台会话仍在运行: Restored ${count} tab(s); the sessions kept running in the background
en.上次的会话已结束，标签页保留，可重新连接: The previous sessions have ended; the tabs are kept so you can reconnect
en.超过保留时间，会话已回收: kept for too long after the page left, so it was reclaimed
en.会话已结束（超过保留时间或已关闭）: The session has ended (its retention window passed or it was closed)
en.多标签交互终端。监控与文件浏览各用一条独立连接，不会打断当前画面；切换工作区再回: A tabbed interactive terminal. Monitoring and file browsing each use their own connection so the screen is never disturbed; switching workspace sessions and coming back re-attaches the running sessions, and a tab only ends when it is closed.
en.共享给 DSH：允许它读取当前屏幕并代你输入命令: Share with DSH: let it read this screen and type commands for you
en.取消共享：DSH 将无法读取或操作这个会话: Stop sharing: DSH can no longer read or drive this session
en.DSH 请求执行危险命令: DSH wants to run a dangerous command
en.只会执行这一次；拒绝后 DSH 不会重试。: Approved for this one time only; DSH does not retry a refusal.
en.该会话没有共享给 DSH（在终端标签上点「共享给 DSH」）: This session is not shared with DSH (click "Share with DSH" on its tab)
en.DSH 正在执行上一条命令，请稍候: DSH is still running the previous command; try again shortly
en.危险命令未获授权（页面长时间没有响应）: The dangerous command was not approved (the page did not answer)
en.危险命令未获授权：${line}: The dangerous command was not approved: ${line}
en.有多个会话匹配「${text}」，请用会话 id: Several sessions match "${text}"; pass a session id
en.没有共享给 DSH 的会话（在终端标签上点「共享给 DSH」）: No session is shared with DSH (click "Share with DSH" on a tab)
en.有多个共享会话，请用 session 参数指定其中一个: Several sessions are shared; name one with the session argument
en.终端里没有已连接的会话。先在「网络运维工具箱 → 终端 / 设备簿」里连接设备，: No terminal session is connected. Open "Network Operations Toolbox → Terminal / devices", connect a device, then click "Share with DSH" on its tab.
en.共 ${count} 个会话；只有已共享的可以读取和操作。: ${count} session(s); only shared ones can be read or driven.
en.用户已收回控制，命令被中断: The user took back control and the command was interrupted
en.等待超时，输出可能还没结束: The wait timed out; more output may still arrive
en.多标签交互终端。监控与文件浏览各用一条独立连接，不会打断当前画面；切换工作区再回: A tabbed interactive terminal. Monitoring and file browsing each use their own connection so the screen is never disturbed; switching workspace sessions and coming back re-attaches the running sessions (they are kept for 20 minutes after you leave), and a tab only ends when it is closed. A tab shared with DSH can be read and driven by the model; dangerous commands wait for your approval in the page. The Float button pins the current tab to a corner window that stays visible while a workspace session is shown.
en.查看共享给 DSH 的终端: Show the terminals shared with DSH
en.更早的输出已被裁剪，只保留最近的会话历史: Older output was trimmed; only the recent session history is left
en.已浮窗：切到工作区会话后，这个终端会留在右上角: Floating: this terminal stays in the top-right corner when you switch to a workspace session
en.取消浮窗：切走后不再保留小窗: Stop floating: the corner window will not be kept when you switch away
en.浮窗：切到工作区会话后，这个终端留在右上角继续显示: Float: keep this terminal in the top-right corner when you switch to a workspace session
en.这是装在 DeepSeek Harness 里的网络运维工作台：${tools}: A network operations workbench inside DeepSeek Harness: ${tools} network and Datacom tools in one panel, with the same capabilities registered as ${agents} agent tools that DSH can call directly.
en.面板与模型共用同一套引擎：同一个工具既能在面板里点，也能被 DSH 直接调用。: The panel and the model share one engine: every tool can be clicked in the panel or called by DSH directly.
en.网络探测都在运行 DSH 的主机侧执行，不受浏览器跨域限制，通常也不需要管理员权: All network probes run on the host that runs DSH, so browser CORS never applies and administrator rights are usually not needed.
en.零第三方依赖：只用 Node 标准库与系统自带命令；SSH 依赖本机的 plin: No third-party dependencies: only the Node standard library and the commands the OS already ships. SSH relies on a local plink or ssh, and iperf3 needs its own executable.
en.数据都放在 ~/.dsh-nwtool：配置备份、拓扑图纸、设备簿与终端转录。: Everything lives under ~/.dsh-nwtool: configuration backups, topology drawings, the device book and terminal transcripts.
en.界面语言跟随 DSH，切换不需要刷新页面；设备密码可加密保存，也可以每次输入。: The UI follows the DSH language and switches without a reload; device passwords can be stored encrypted or typed each time.
en.下面这些工具注册给模型，可以直接在对话里让它调用，也可以写进提示词让它自己挑。描: These tools are registered for the model: it can call them from a conversation, or pick one from a prompt. 'Read-only' in a description means the device and this machine are not modified.
en.对主机做 ICMP 探测，返回每包往返时延、TTL 与丢包统计。: Ping a host over ICMP and return per-packet round-trip time, TTL and loss statistics.
en.对指定 TCP 端口测量连接耗时，ICMP 被过滤时也能判断可达性。: Measure TCP connect time to a port; works when ICMP is filtered.
en.逐跳追踪到目标的路径，给出每跳往返时延与丢包。: Trace the path hop by hop with per-hop round-trip time and loss.
en.查询域名解析；指定 server 时用原始 DNS 报文（等价 dig），省略则: Resolve a name; pass a server to query it with a raw DNS message (dig semantics), or omit it to use the system resolver.
en.从运行 DSH 的主机发 HTTP 请求，返回状态码、响应头、耗时与正文，适合验: Send an HTTP request from the machine running DSH and return status, headers, timing and body — handy for checking an API.
en.对单台主机做 TCP connect 扫描，列出开放端口。: TCP connect scan of one host, listing open ports.
en.在网段、地址范围或单个地址中发现存活主机。: Discover live hosts in a subnet, an address range or a single address.
en.纯子网计算：网络地址、广播地址、可用范围、通配符掩码与二进制。: Pure subnet math: network and broadcast address, usable range, wildcard mask and binary notation.
en.通过 UDP 查询 NTP/SNTP，报告本机时钟偏差、往返时延与服务器层级；只: Query NTP/SNTP over UDP and report the local clock offset, round-trip delay and server stratum. Read-only: the system clock is never changed.
en.查询 IP 的归属地、运营商与 ASN；内网与保留地址在本地判断，不外发。: Look up an IP's location, ISP and ASN; private and reserved ranges are classified locally and never sent out.
en.列出本机 TCP/UDP 套接字：本地与对端地址、状态、所属进程与 PID。只读: List the local TCP/UDP sockets: local and remote address, state, owning process and PID. Read-only.
en.读取本机 ARP / 邻居缓存：地址、MAC、厂商与接口。只读，增删需要管理员权: Read the local ARP / neighbour cache: address, MAC, vendor and interface. Read-only; adding or deleting entries needs administrator rights.
en.列出已归档的设备配置备份，最新的在前。: List archived device configuration backups, newest first.
en.按 id 读取一份配置备份，输出有长度上限，便于逐段审阅。: Read one stored backup by id; the output is capped so it stays reviewable.
en.在一份配置（备份 id 或原始文本）里搜关键字，返回命中行与上下文。: Search a configuration (a backup id or raw text) for a keyword and return the matching lines with context.
en.对比两份配置（两份备份或两段文本），报告新增、删除与修改的行。: Compare two configurations (two backups or two texts) and report added, removed and changed lines.
en.通过 SSH/Telnet 在一台或多台设备上执行一组只读命令，可把输出归档成备: Run a set of read-only commands on one or more devices over SSH/Telnet, optionally archiving the output as a backup.
en.用 SNMP v2c GET 读 SYSTEM 组，识别设备名称、描述、型号与运: Identify devices with SNMP v2c GET on the SYSTEM group: name, description, model and uptime.
en.查同一功能在华为 VRP/H3C Comware 与思科 IOS/NX-OS 里: Look up the equivalent command across Huawei VRP / H3C Comware and Cisco IOS / NX-OS.
en.查看或操作你共享给 DSH 的终端会话；默认不共享，只有你明确共享的会话可用。: See or drive a terminal session you shared with DSH. Sessions are private by default; only the ones you explicitly shared are reachable.
